$comment: One JSON object per line (JSONL). Limits: max 100 records, max 1048576 bytes per drop, max 100000 chars of text per record.
description: One record of a bulk file-drop. Host supplies content (text and/or public http/https url); the plugin never fetches in this validator. Provenance is always host_provided. Dedup key is SHA-256 of posting text. Drops stage under PLUGIN_DATA; relative staged paths only.

url.description: Public http/https only: rejects file:, credentials, non-public hosts.

stagedPath.description: Portable relative path only; no traversal, no absolute paths.
